observations: Lower speeds give drivers more time to detect hazards and reduce distance travelled during reaction.
Lower speeds reduce braking distance and the likelihood of loss of vehicle control.
Other road users have more opportunity to estimate the vehicle speed and avoid a collision.
Legal speed compliance is a ceiling, while actual speed must also account for conditions and foreseeable hazards.
limitations: Historical examples on the page are not republished as current statistics in this knowledge release.
